records.Current: `f"SELECT * FROM public.{p}"` and `f"INSERT INTO :schema.:flat_name {union_all}"` use f-string interpolation for table names in migration
records.Target: All SQL MUST use parameterized queries via `sa.text()` with bound parameters or SQLAlchemy ORM; no f-string interpolation
records.Delta: f-string SQL concatenation in migration script builds dynamic SQL with user-influenced partition names
records.Fix: Replace f-string with `sa.text()` using bound parameters and `sqlalchemy.sql.quoted_name`

records.Current: `sql = f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {validated_table}"` and `sql = f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {validated_table} WHERE {where}"` — uses f-string for table name and WHERE clause
records.Target: All SQL MUST use parameterized queries via `sa.text()` with bound parameters
records.Delta: f-string SQL in analytics service builds dynamic queries with interpolated table/where strings
records.Fix: Replace with `sa.text()` using bound parameters; validate table name against allowlist

records.Target: Admin-entered API keys and webhook secrets MUST be encrypted via `infrastructure/security/field_encryption.py` (AES-256-GCM) before being saved to `finance.payment_gateway_connections`
records.Delta: Payment gateway credentials are stored in plaintext in the database
records.Fix: Encrypt `secret_key`, `webhook_secret`, `public_key` with `field_encryptor.encrypt()` before assignment; migrate `PaymentGatewayConnection` columns to `EncryptedString`

records.Current: Multiple providers use `urllib.request.urlopen()` and `httpx.get/post` with caller-influenced URLs without validating against `is_safe_url()`
records.Target: All outbound HTTP requests MUST validate URLs via `infrastructure/security/url_security.py` (`is_safe_url()` / `require_safe_url()`) before fetching
records.Delta: Outbound HTTP requests to internal/private IPs are possible via SSRF
records.Fix: Wrap all outbound HTTP calls with `require_safe_url()` validation; block private/loopback/metadata IPs

records.Current: `f"SELECT {select_cols_sql} FROM {safe_table} ORDER BY {safe_pk} LIMIT :lim OFFSET :off"` — while `safe_table` and `safe_pk` are quoted, `select_cols_sql` is built via f-string
records.Target: All SQL MUST use parameterized queries; column lists built via f-string are still injection-prone if input validation is bypassed
records.Delta: f-string SQL in key rotation builds SELECT with f-string interpolated column list
records.Fix: Use `sa.text()` with bound parameters or ORM query builder for all dynamic SQL

records.Current: 16 temporary debug/query scripts (`_tmp_*.py`, `_audit_boot_check.py`) remain in `backend/` root
records.Target: Law 27: root-level `fix_*.py`, `debug_*.py`, `_tmp_*.py` MUST be removed after use

records.Fix: Remove all `_tmp_*.py` and debug scripts from `backend/` root; add to `.gitignore`

records.Current: `cors_origins: str = Field(default="http://localhost:3000,http://127.0.0.1:3000")` — default CORS origins include localhost/127.0.0.1
records.Target: CORS defaults MUST NOT include localhost/127.0.0.1; production validation rejects these but defaults are insecure for any environment
records.Delta: Insecure default CORS origins could be accidentally used in staging/development if validation is bypassed
records.Fix: Change default to empty string `""`; require explicit CORS_ORIGINS in all environments

records.Current: WORM audit service performs `UPDATE audit_logs SET details = jsonb_set(...)` after INSERT to append `worm_hash`
records.Target: WORM audit trail must be truly immutable — compute chain hash before INSERT and include it in the initial INSERT statement
records.Delta: Updating a row after insert violates Write-Once-Read-any (WORM) principle; audit trail can be tampered with between INSERT and UPDATE
records.Fix: Compute `worm_hash` and `worm_prev_hash` before INSERT; include in initial row; remove post-INSERT UPDATE

records.Current: `verify_captcha()` returns immediately when `TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY` is not configured, skipping CAPTCHA verification entirely
records.Target: CAPTCHA verification MUST be mandatory in production for all public auth endpoints (register, login, forgot-password, reset-password)
records.Delta: Missing Turnstile secret key silently disables bot protection on all public auth endpoints
records.Fix: Raise `HTTP 500` or fail closed when CAPTCHA is required but secret key is missing in production

records.Current: `_RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED = str(os.getenv("RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED", "false")).lower() in ("true", "1", "yes")` and `if app_env == "test" or not settings.rate_limit_enabled: return await call_next(request)` — rate limiting is disabled by default and in test mode
records.Target: Rate limiting MUST be enabled by default in production (Law 37: rate limit fails closed)
records.Delta: Rate limiting is disabled by default and bypassed in test mode, allowing brute-force attacks if misconfigured
records.Fix: Change default to `true`; ensure Valkey-backed rate limiting is enforced in all non-development environments

records.Current: `public_router` is registered at `/api/v1` prefix with endpoints `/ghost-employees`, `/impossible-travel`, `/{employee_id}/risk-score`, `/team-health/{manager_id}`, `/{employee_id}/audit-timeline` — while these endpoints have `require_admin`, the misleading `public_router` name and `/api/v1` prefix could lead to accidental exposure if copied without auth
records.Target: Public routers MUST be explicitly named and reviewed; consider renaming to `admin_router` or moving to admin namespace to prevent accidental exposure
records.Delta: Misleading `public_router` name for admin-protected endpoints creates risk of auth bypass if pattern is copied elsewhere
records.Fix: Rename `public_router` to `admin_router`; move endpoints to `/api/v1/admin/` namespace; add CI lint rule

records.Fix: Change log level to `logger.debug` or sanitize `details` to exclude sensitive fields before logging
